Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 448C of 2010 for the offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

3. At the outset, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that the petitioner did not comply with the order dated 29.07.2013 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 22062 of 2013 by a co-ordinate Bench,
whereby he was granted the privilege of anticipatory bail on the condition that besides the other conditions mentioned in the order, he shall pay Rs. 5,000/- per month to the complainant by way of interim maintenance.
As Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.69985 of 2024(5) dt.08-04-2025 such, he should not be granted the privilege of anticipatory bail again.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits in paragraph no. 2 that his earlier anticipatory bail application being Cr. Misc. No. 22062 of 2013 was allowed vide order dated 29.07.2013 by which he was directed to furnish bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- with two sureties of like amount along with bank draft of Rs. 5,000/- (per month) payable in favour of O.P. No.2, within stipulated period, which he failed to comply with.

5.
